metadata.description: Product design skills by Raul Loureiro

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: Fifteen skills for enterprise product design work. Start with either an evidence-backed problem frame or a short creative brief for aligning design meetings, explore two or three solution directions inside a fixed time budget, wireframe the chosen screens, diagram what people are stuck on, then write a proposal someone can approve or decline. A context-intake skill turns raw material into durable project context. A pitch skill works out how to explain a decision already made, and renderers turn it into a scrollytelling explainer, a Figma Slides deck or a local tldraw canvas. Utilities capture writing and visual style and strip AI tells from prose.
